anti_tautology_read: High similarity means shared vocabulary, not shared mechanism. Use bridge candidates only when they propose a new discriminator. Current expected use: connect H75/H78 activation-contract artifacts back to H50-H55 response/schema surfaces, then ask what held-out feature would separate family/schema compression from checkpoint residual geometry.
boundary: Jaccard graph is a traversal instrument. It can suggest bridges, coverage gaps, and over-clusters; it cannot promote scientific claims.
